_comment: Counties that the ND SoS 'Statewide Polling Places' export (Precincts.aspx tab 5)
omits even though vip.sos.nd.gov/WhereToVote.aspx publishes their general-election
polling places. WhereToVote is the tool voters are pointed at, and it is the source
this whole polling-place model is derived from, so its answer wins over the summary
scripts/step1-update-polling-places.py appends these rows ONLY when the export has
no rows for the county at all. When the SoS fixes the export, the supplement is
skipped automatically and can be deleted -- check for the 'SKIP supplement' warning.
Do NOT add a county here just because it is missing from the export. Confirm on
Election - Voting Information for...' and lists locations. Ransom County, for
contrast, says 'This information has not been established at this time by the
county', so it is correctly left out and voters there are shown nothing.

why: Rolette County (Turtle Mountain Reservation) had 25 rows in the eid=346 export
as of 2026-04-07 and has zero in eid=348 as of 2026-09-02, but WhereToVote
serves all five vote centers for all five precincts under the '2026 General
Election' heading. 7,340 of the state's 911 addresses are in Rolette County,
so dropping it would strip Turtle Mountain voters of their polling places.
Hours read from the Date/Time(s) panel: 11/03 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM.
Dunseith City Hall's address is taken from WhereToVote (13 1st St E); the April
export said 101 Peace Garden Ave, which Google's address-verified place record

dropboxes.polling_hours: The deadline to return absentee ballots is by 7:00pm on Tuesday, November 3rd.

why: WhereToVote returns 'This information has not been established at this time by
the county. It will be made available as soon as possible.' for Ransom County,
and the eid=348 export has no Ransom rows in either the polling-places or the
drop-box tab. The eid=346 export listed EXPO (Lisbon) and City Auditors Office
(Enderlin), but those were the June primary's locations.
Following the official source, the app shows Ransom voters no polling place
rather than a location the county has not confirmed for November.
RE-CHECK THIS at every refresh: as soon as WhereToVote publishes Ransom's
locations, remove this entry so the addresses get their polling places back.
